title: The Shadow Wolf Pack
story: A pack of 24 shadow wolves circles the shepherd's flock under a moonless sky! Mr 6 lights his enchanted torch, and its golden flame is too bright for most of the pack — 2/3 of the wolves melt back into the night at the very first flicker.
question: How many shadow wolves remain for Mr 6 to face?
hint: First find 2/3 of 24 — split 24 into 3 equal groups and count 2 of them. Those flee. How many are left?
victory: Only 8 wolves remain, and up close Mr 6 sees they aren't shadows at all — just cold, hungry pups! He shares his supper by the torchlight, and the shepherd gains 8 loyal sheepdogs by dawn.
